implementedRequests.receivedAudio: Manual initial remote subscriptions; ordinary microphone and unknown-source audio retained. Extra screen_share_audio defaults off and is enabled explicitly per screen tile.
implementedRequests.ownScreenCompanion: All publications from the local authenticated UUID :screen companion are excluded.
implementedRequests.screenSoundControl: Stream-Ton an/aus selects at most one normalized owner; screen video remains independent. Selection clears when the owner audio disappears, call leaves or channel moves.
implementedRequests.lifecycle: Serialized deny-before-allow subscription changes, room/call/revision guards and new-publication/initial/reconnect application. Same policy gates playback gain and deafen.
implementedRequests.failedSignaling: Failed subscription direction retained; explicit retry safely rejoins with autoSubscribe=false without globally ending the connected call. Failed denies are never reset through a temporary true.

nativeUnitTests.scope: Shipping source frozen before unit/build. Synthetic fixtures; no authenticated room or media capture.

boundedCodeReview.scope: Pinned SDK API, initial publication behavior, reconnect intent, serialized revision guards and callback loops.
correctedFindings: Failed false must not be mistaken for successful retry after SDK preference no-op.
Failed true followed by disable must still write false; retain failed direction per SID.

warnings: Existing pinned LiveKit E2EEOptions deprecation; no encryption migration in this change.
AppIntents extraction skipped because this app has no AppIntents dependency.

verificationLimits.causalQualification: Screen audio is a plausible extra playback path; this does not establish the reported live cause. AEC was already enabled in the pinned SDK and was not speculatively changed.
verificationLimits.securityScope: Source/package/hash checks are bounded inspection evidence, not a comprehensive malware audit or a safety guarantee.
